prompt: Match each connectivity option to its defining property.
explanation: Each option solves a different problem: VPC peering opens unrestricted private access between two VPCs but needs non-overlapping CIDRs on AWS; Private Service Connect is the Google Cloud alternative that tolerates overlapping CIDRs; Transit Gateway is the AWS routing alternative for the same problem; the CIDR allow list filters source IPs on both endpoint types; and dynamic endpoints are the redirectable three-word hostnames ending in db.redis.io.

pairs.right: Unrestricted private access between two VPCs; AWS consumer CIDRs must not overlap
Google Cloud option that still works when CIDR ranges overlap
AWS routing alternative when CIDR ranges overlap
Filters source IPs on both the public and the private endpoint
Three-word hostname ending in db.redis.io that can be redirected
